vehicleJourneyId.description: Required. Also known as 'turnummer'/trip number of the journey

lineId.description: Required. Id for the line, e.g.: 'RUT:Line:32'

firstDepartureDateTime.description: Required. Please provide an iso date time for when the journey departs. DateTime as specified in the [ADT documentation.](https://adt.transhub.io)

lastArrivalDateTime.description: Optional. Use this field to limit the calls the vehicle plans to service. DateTime as specified in the [ADT documentation.](https://adt.transhub.io)
